Year-over-year diffing of name+employer pairs detects moves between institutions and departures without any press release.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Czech event branded 'Banking Summit' was found. Searching 'Retail Summit 2026 Praha program řečníci Banking Summit' returned only Blue Events' Retail Summit / New Retail Summit (SK) and unrelated foreign summits.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'Banking Summit' element of the cell definition appears to be either an alias for another event (most plausibly ČBA's Payments Summit or the Banking Innovation Forum) or a non-CZ brand. Treated as unresolved, not as a discovered source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated source entry and flags that the cell brief's event list needs correcting so downstream collection is not scheduled against a non-existent event.

negative_findings.description: No award or conference series branded exactly 'Bankovní inovace' was located in CZ. The cs query surfaced adjacent but differently-named things: VŠE's 'Rozvoj a inovace finančních produktů', 'Banking Innovation Forum & Expo', Economia's 'Inovace v platebních kartách' and Měšec's 'FIN (R)Evoluce'.
negative_findings.result_summary: The concept exists in CZ but is distributed across several separately-branded events rather than one 'Bankovní inovace' brand.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must target the four real event brands rather than a single assumed one, or the innovation/digital-leadership title layer will be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: The Payments Summit (ČBA) page fetched showed no visible archive of past editions — only the current 2026 speakers/programme. Speakers are also added incrementally ('additional speakers will be announced').
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical speaker rosters for this high-value ČBA event may not be retrievable from the live site. Recorded as a hypothesis from a single fetch, not a verdict.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Title-drift detection needs two editions. If no on-site archive exists, the collector must snapshot every crawl itself and backfill from the Wayback Machine, otherwise the first year yields no signal at all.

negative_findings.description: For Zlatý měšec (Měšec.cz), cs search did not surface a page naming jury members, unlike Zlatá koruna and Banka roku. Only voting and results pages were found.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids over-scoring an award as a personnel census when only its results are public.

negative_findings.description: cashlessfuture.cz surfaced with 2022 as the most recent identifiable edition; no 2023-2026 edition was found in cs or en search.

negative_findings.description: Across all cs and en queries in this cell, no event or award source was found that publishes job vacancies or hiring volume. Speaker/jury rosters reveal incumbency and role changes only.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'jobs'/'hiring' topics of the run scope are structurally under-served by the events-and-awards cell.

brief: The CZ events-and-awards layer is unusually rich for role-census purposes: Zlatá koruna's Finanční akademie publishes a named ~400-person roster with employers every year under a stable /soutez/{YEAR} archive going back to roughly 2009, and Mastercard Banka roku publishes a bio'd expert jury plus a CEO-level conference panel each autumn — together these give a free, self-updating, deeply archived time series of who holds which seat. The conference layer splits cleanly by role class: ČBA's Payments Summit and CGI's Trendy v platebním styku expose the payments-operations and transaction-banking layer, IT ve finančnictví the CIO/CISO layer, FinTech Roadmap the founder/innovation layer, VŠE's Rozvoj a inovace finančních produktů and ČNB's speech archive the board and regulator layer, and Blue Events' Retail Summit the merchant/acceptance side. The main structural weaknesses are archive depth outside Zlatá koruna and ČNB (Payments Summit showed no visible past-edition archive on the page fetched, so self-snapshotting plus a Wayback backfill is required to get a two-edition baseline), a strong Prague bias, and no dedicated CZ acquiring/POS-vendor event. Note that two names in the cell brief — 'Banking Summit' and 'Bankovní inovace' — did not resolve to real standalone CZ event brands and are logged as negative findings rather than invented sources; note also that this cell yields incumbency and title-drift signal but essentially no vacancy or hiring-volume signal, which must come from other cells.
